channel.title: Worcester Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Worcester Business Journal (wbjournal.com)

item.title: Telegram & Gazette to shift to postal delivery
item.description: The paper cited the changing realities of the journalism industry, with consumers turning to online coverage to receive breaking news coverage.

item.title: Spectrum acquires NECN, Worcester news operations to remain unchanged
item.description: Spectrum News One in Worcester is being rebranded as Spectrum News NECN after the Connecticut-based business reached an agreement to buy the assets of New England Cable News.

item.title: Leominster industrial site sold for $4M to Maynard real estate firm
item.description: Maynard-based real estate investment firm The LexVest Group has purchased the site of a 62,259-square-foot industrial building for $4 million. An entity managed by LexVest purchased the site at 44 […]

item.title: Social equity businesses push cannabis regulators to extend cannabis delivery license exclusivity
item.description: Social equity applicants are those who have been disproportionately affected by previous marijuana prohibition and enforcement activities.

item.title: WBJ Daily Report to switch to morning delivery in March
item.description: Starting on March 2, the WBJ Daily Report will be sent at 8:30 a.m. Monday through Friday, switching from its previous noon delivery time.

item.title: Long-term Worcester senior living executive director retires
item.description: Joan Cusson stepped down from her executive position on Friday.

item.title: 🔒 Private equity invests in Littleton-based fire safety and security firm
item.description: RF Investment Partners, a growth capital investor based in New York and focused on lower-middle market businesses, has partnered with Chicago-based private equity firm Prairie Capital to make the investment.

item.title: Boston Scientific adds Starbucks CFO and biopharma giant CEO to board
item.description: Cathy Smith and Christophe Weber joined Boston Scientific’s board on Wednesday.

item.title: Sweetgreen opening first Worcester County location
item.description: The firm has not announced the store’s opening date yet.

item.title: WBJ Economic Forecast event to feature Bank of America economist
item.description: Mishra’s focus is on analyzing the labor market and GDP outlook. She regularly contributes to the “BofA on USA” card data report and has appeared on CNBC, CNN, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, and Financial Times.
